title: TIER/Dott Vehicle
description: A free-floating shared micromobility vehicle (e-scooter or e-bike) operated by Dott (formerly TIER), as published in the GBFS 2.3 free_bike_status feed.

bike_id.description: Rotating opaque identifier for the vehicle (UUID).

lat.description: Latitude of the vehicle's last reported location.

lon.description: Longitude of the vehicle's last reported location.

is_reserved.description: True when the vehicle is currently reserved by a rider.

is_disabled.description: True when the vehicle is offline (low battery, maintenance, out of zone).

current_range_meters.description: Estimated remaining range in meters at the current battery level.

current_fuel_percent.description: Battery level as a fraction between 0 and 1.

last_reported.description: POSIX timestamp of the vehicle's last telemetry update.

rental_uris.description: Deep links for unlocking the vehicle on each platform.
